Hi there hello.

I put the tinfoil hat back on and went looking for some new conspiracy theories to believe in. Unfortunately the internet had other ideas. In this episode we investigate a theory about the Titanic secretly being switched with its sister ship, a scientific breakthrough proving light bulbs actually suck dark, Elvis possibly appearing in Home Alone, the government using Powerball to catch time travelers, and Disney allegedly burying a conspiracy about Walt’s frozen head with a very strategic movie title.

So yes, things got a little weird.
